# 1 Chronicles Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 376v–377r

---

**11:1** And-gathered all Yisra'el to David at-Chevron, saying: Behold, your-bone and-your-flesh [are] we. **11:2** Also previously [gam etmol gam shilshom], also when-was Sha'ul king, you [were] the-one-leading-out and-the-one-bringing-in Yisra'el. And-said YHWH your-God to-you: You shall-shepherd my-people Yisra'el, and-you shall-be leader [nagid] over my-people Yisra'el.

**11:3** And-came all the-elders of-Yisra'el to the-king at-Chevron, and-cut David with-them a-covenant in-Chevron before YHWH, and-they-anointed David as-king over Yisra'el, according-to the-word of-YHWH by-the-hand of-Shemu'el.

**11:4** And-went David and-all Yisra'el [to] Yerushalayim — it [is] Yevus — and-there the-Yevusi, the-inhabitants of-the-land. **11:5** And-said the-inhabitants of-Yevus to-David: You-shall-not come here. And-captured David the-fortress [metsudah] of-Tsiyon — it [is] the-city of-David. **11:6** And-said David: Whoever strikes the-Yevusi first [barishonah] shall-be chief [rosh] and-commander [sar]. And-went-up first [barishonah] Yo'av son of-Tseruyah, and-he-became chief.

**11:7** And-dwelt David in-the-fortress [ba-metsudah]; therefore they-called it the-city of-David. **11:8** And-he-built the-city all-around, from the-Millo and-to all-around, and-Yo'av restored [yechayeh] the-rest of-the-city. **11:9** And-went David going and-becoming-great [halokh vegadol], and-YHWH of-hosts [tseva'ot] [was] with-him.

**11:10** And-these [are] the-chiefs [rashei] of-the-mighty-men [ha-gibborim] who [belonged] to-David, who-strengthened-themselves with-him in-his-kingdom, with all Yisra'el, to-make-him-king, according-to the-word of-YHWH concerning Yisra'el.

**11:11** And-this [is] the-number [mispar] of-the-mighty-men [ha-gibborim] who [belonged] to-David: Yashovam son of-a-Hachmoni, chief [rosh] of-the-thirty [ha-sheloshim]; he wielded his-spear [chanito] against three-hundred, slain [chalalim] at-one time [be-fa'am echat].

**11:12** And-after-him Elazar son of-Dodo, the-Achochi; he [was] among-the-three of-the-mighty-men. **11:13** He was with-David at-Pas-Dammim, and-the-Pelishtim gathered there for-battle, and-was a-portion of-the-field full of-barley [se'orim], and-the-people fled from-before the-Pelishtim. **11:14** And-they-stationed-themselves in-the-middle of-the-portion and-delivered-it, and-struck the-Pelishtim. And-saved YHWH a-great salvation [teshu'ah gedolah].

**11:15** And-went-down three of the-thirty chiefs [rosh] to the-rock, to David, to the-cave of-Adullam, and-the-camp of-the-Pelishtim [was] encamped in-the-valley of-Refa'im. **11:16** And-David [was] then in-the-stronghold [ba-metsudah], and-the-garrison [netsiv] of-the-Pelishtim [was] then in-Beit-Lechem. **11:17** And-desired [vayit'avveh] David and-said: Who will-give-me-drink [yashqeni] of-water from-the-well [bor] of-Beit-Lechem which [is] at-the-gate? **11:18** And-broke-through the-three through-the-camp of-the-Pelishtim and-drew water from-the-well of-Beit-Lechem which [was] at-the-gate, and-carried [it] and-brought [it] to David. And-not was-willing David to-drink-it, and-poured-it-out [vaynassekh] to-YHWH. **11:19** And-said: Far-be-it [chalilah] to-me from-my-God to-do this! Shall-I-drink the-blood of-these men with [be] their-lives [nafshot]? For with [be] their-lives they-brought-it. And-not was-willing to-drink-it. These [things] did the-three of-the-mighty-men.

**11:20** And-Avshai the-brother of-Yo'av — he was chief [rosh] of-the-three. And-he wielded his-spear against three-hundred slain, and-to-him [was] a-name among-the-three. **11:21** From the-three — of-the-two he-was-honored [nikhbad], and-he-became to-them as-commander [le-sar], and-to the-three he-did-not attain.

**11:22** Benayahu son of-Yehoyada, son of-a-man of-valor [ish chayil], great of-deeds [rav pe'alim], from Qavtse'el. He struck two of-Ari'el of-Mo'av. And-he went-down and-struck the-lion [ha-ari] in-the-midst of-the-pit [ha-bor] on-a-day of-the-snow. **11:23** And-he struck the-Egyptian [ha-mitsri] man, a-man of-measure [middah], five by-the-cubit [ammot]. And-in-the-hand of-the-Egyptian [was] a-spear like-a-weaver's-beam [manor oregim], and-he-went-down to-him with-a-staff [ba-shevet], and-snatched [vayigzol] the-spear from-the-hand of-the-Egyptian, and-killed-him with-his-own spear. **11:24** These [things] did Benayahu son of-Yehoyada, and-to-him [was] a-name among-the-three of-the-mighty-men. **11:25** Behold, from-the-thirty he-was-honored [nikhbad], and-to the-three he-did-not attain. And-David set-him over his-bodyguard [mishma'to].

**11:26** And-the-mighty-men of-valor [gibborei ha-chayil]: Asa'el the-brother of-Yo'av, Elchanan son of-Dodo from-Beit-Lechem, **11:27** Shammot the-Harori, Chelets the-Peloni, **11:28** Ira son of-Iqqesh the-Teqo'i, Avi'ezer the-Antoti, **11:29** Sibbechai the-Chushati, Ilai the-Achohi, **11:30** Maharai the-Netofati, Cheled son of-Ba'anah the-Netofati, **11:31** Itai son of-Rivai from-Giv'ah of-the-sons of-Binyamin, Benayah the-Pir'atoni, **11:32** Churai from-the-wadis of-Ga'ash, Avi'el the-Arvati, **11:33** Azmavet the-Bacharumi, Elyachba the-Sha'alvoni, **11:34** the-sons of-Hashem the-Gizoni, Yonatan son of-Shageh the-Harari, **11:35** Achiam son of-Sakhar the-Harari, Elifal son of-Ur, **11:36** Chefer the-Mekhrati, Achiyyah the-Peloni, **11:37** Chetsro the-Karmeli, Na'arai son of-Ezbai, **11:38** Yo'el the-brother of-Natan, Mivchar son of-Hagri, **11:39** Tseleq the-Ammoni, Nachrai the-Beroti, armor-bearer of-Yo'av son of-Tseruyah, **11:40** Ira the-Yitri, Garev the-Yitri, **11:41** Uriyyah the-Chitti, Zavad son of-Achlai, **11:42** Adina son of-Shiza the-Re'uveni, chief [rosh] of-the-Re'uveni, and-thirty with-him, **11:43** Chanan son of-Ma'akhah, and-Yoshafat the-Mitni, **11:44** Uzziyyah the-Ashtarot, Shama and-Ye'i'el the-sons of-Chotam the-Aro'eri, **11:45** Yedi'a'el son of-Shimri, and-Yocha his-brother, the-Titsi, **11:46** Eli'el the-Machavimi, and-Yerivai and-Yoshavyah, the-sons of-Elna'am, and-Yitmah the-Mo'avi, **11:47** Eli'el, and-Oved, and-Ya'asi'el the-Metsobayah.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — nagid:** "Leader/prince" — the Chronicler's preferred term for the divinely designated ruler, distinct from *melek* (king). David is *nagid* by divine appointment, *melek* by popular acclamation.

**v.11 — "the thirty" vs. "the three":** The MT reads *ha-sheloshim* (thirty) here, but the parallel in 2 Sam 23:8 reads *ha-sheloshah* (three). The Chronicler's text may reflect a different Vorlage or scribal variation.

**v.18-19 — vaynassekh:** David "poured it out" — the verb *nasakh* is used for libation offerings. The water becomes a sacred offering, the warriors' risk transformed into worship.

**v.22 — Ari'el of Mo'av:** Literally "lion of God of Moab" — an obscure phrase. It may refer to two champion warriors (*ari'el* as a title), or to some feature of Moab. The meaning is disputed.

**v.41-47 — Chronicler's additions:** Sixteen names (vv.41-47) not found in 2 Samuel 23. The Chronicler expands the list, including a Reubenite, an Ammonite, a Hittite, and a Moabite — a remarkably inclusive roster.

*— EMET*
